## Goal

summarize work done

## Summary

Built Federal Marketplace Assessor prototype (assess.py). A runnable Python script providing one-command PSC code market assessments for small software teams. Uses cached E206 experiment data for instant results. Validated across 7030 (PROCEED - best for direct sales) and DA10 (PROCEED - best for GSA Schedule/GWAC pathway). Other codes gracefully degrade. Prototype addresses concrete problem: small teams have no easy way to assess federal marketplace opportunities. Next: use as evaluation framework for E208 field test, or expand cached data to cover all 5 PSC codes.

## Next

Either: (1) Run E206 CLI with all modules to generate complete cached data for assessor, or (2) Design and recruit for E208 field test with 3-5 small software companies to validate assessment framework against real pipeline opportunities.
